messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Dedicated pool 'vesper-eu-dedicated' experiencing sustained p99 latency spike for customer 'Vesper Enterprise' in eu-west-1. p95 -> 1.2s, p99 -> 6.2s. Errors up. Severity: P2. Paging oncall-sre.
Alice Chen: Taking page, assembling warroom. Rafael, can you take lead? /cc @Rafael Ortiz
Rafael Ortiz: I'm on. Rafael (SRE) taking lead — switching to incident channel. Quick status pls observability.
Priya Malhotra: Tailing metrics now. Heap: high token count on several nodes. KV cache miss rate jumped. Query distribution shows a single tenant 'vesper-prod-01' skewing traffic to long-tail prompts.
Marta Gomez: FYI customer success: Vesper reported checkout timeouts 4m ago, customers seeing 504s.
Devon Park: Noted. Any model variant changes recently? Could be quantization path hitting a regression.
svc-monitor: Recent deploys: none in eu-west for runtime in last 2h. Autoscale events: none. Pool utilization at 94%.
Rafael Ortiz: Action plan: 1) isolate noisy tenant 2) divert ~10% traffic to warm spare region (eu-north) 3) if needed, evict tenant from pool 4) temporary model fallback to lower-latency variant. Who can run evict/route commands?
Priya Malhotra: I can run infra commands. Executing read-only checks first.
Priya Malhotra: Quick logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T14:02:11Z] tenant=vesper-prod-01 req_id=abc123 latency=5.9s tokens=12000
[2026-03-17T14:02:12Z] tenant=vesper-prod-01 kv_cache_miss=true batch_size=48
[2026-03-17T14:02:13Z] kernel_fallback=fp32 exec_time=5.6s
```
Devon Park: Looks like batched offline jobs hitting production slice. Might be a runaway batch inference loop from Vesper side.
Marta Gomez: I'm pinging Vesper AE and product lead: "We're investigating high latency risk, temporary mitigations in progress. Expect updates every 15m." Liam, can you confirm comms?
Liam O'Connor: Messaged account and product. They confirm a backend job started ~14:00 UTC — they think it's a scheduled aggregation gone hot. Ask them to pause if possible.
Priya Malhotra: Preparing tenant isolation. Command (running):
```
rictl tenant isolate --pool vesper-eu-dedicated --tenant vesper-prod-01 --mode throttle --qps 10
```
Priya Malhotra: Isolation applied: throttled to 10 qps for tenant vesper-prod-01. Observability: immediate drop in tokens/sec from that tenant.
svc-monitor: After throttle: p95 down to 360ms, p99 still ~1.6s. Error rate decreasing but still elevated.
Rafael Ortiz: Good. Next: divert 10% to eu-north warm spare. Priya, can you create a canary route?
Priya Malhotra: Running route change: 
```
rictl routing create-canary --from pool:vesper-eu-dedicated --to pool:vesper-eu-north-warm --percent 10 --match tenant:vesper
```
Priya Malhotra: Canary live. Monitoring.
svc-monitor: Canary traffic shows p99 ~420ms on eu-north for same tenant. Success.
Devon Park: Suggest fallback model for heavy requests: switch tenant to 'guanaco-13b-fp16' for high-latency prompts.
Rafael Ortiz: Approve fallback. Priya apply.
Priya Malhotra: Applying per-tenant model override:
```
rictl tenant override-model --tenant vesper-prod-01 --model guanaco-13b-fp16 --reason "latency mitigation"
```
Priya Malhotra: Model override active.
svc-monitor: Observed p99 for tenant drop to ~300ms after override + routing. Cluster-wide p99 now 280ms.
Marta Gomez: Vesper acknowledged pause of their scheduled job — they paused and will patch tomorrow.
Rafael Ortiz: Decision: keep throttle + model override + 10% canary divert for 30m. Do NOT evict tenant for now. Escalate to Eng-ML postmortem for batching detection.
Devon Park: Filing ML follow-up: detect runaway batched jobs and enforce tenant-level batch limits.
Alice Chen: Noting action items: 1) Add tenant qps/qpt limits (infra) 2) Auto-detect abnormal token deltas (observability) 3) Customer guidance for scheduling heavy offline jobs to dedicated maintenance windows.
Rafael Ortiz: Incident-bot status: SLO breach window recorded for 11:56-12:03 UTC. Please tag for postmortem.
incident-bot: Log: SLO breach recorded (p99 > 1s) for customer: Vesper Enterprise. Incident ID INC-20260317-04. Tickets created: PM-342 (postmortem), OPS-789 (follow-up infra work).
Liam O'Connor: Vesper wants a postmortem and ETA on permanent fixes. I've scheduled a customer sync tomorrow. Marta will lead comms.
Marta Gomez: I'll send a summary to the account with mitigation timeline and next steps after we close warroom.
Rafael Ortiz: Final checks: monitoring sustained stable for 12m. p99 steady ~220ms. No new spikes. Anyone object to closing warroom in 10m?
Devon Park: No objections.
Alice Chen: Thanks all — great fast coordination. Rafael, please capture notes for the PM and assign owners.
Rafael Ortiz: Will draft postmortem and tag Priya/Devon for infra & ML action items. Closing warroom in 7m unless regressions.
incident-bot: Warroom closed by Rafael Ortiz at 6732105567. Summary: mitigation successful via tenant throttle, fallback model, and partial routing. Root cause: tenant scheduled batch job causing large batched inference on dedicated pool. Follow-ups assigned.
